SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency

    TRIM(regexp_replace(ss.abor_security_group_id, '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2]))) AS SECURITY_GROUP_ID, 
    MAX(shm.balance_nominal_number) / 1000 AS POSITION, SUM(0) / 1000 AS REPOPOSITION, 
    TRIM(asi.cusip) AS CUSIP, TRIM(asi.isin) AS ISIN, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as LAST_UPDATE_TIME 
    from reference.scd_securities ss
    join  holdings.scd_holdings_main shm on shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number and ss.business_date = shm.business_date 
	left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on asi.cppib_sec_id = cast(shm.cppib_sec_id as int) and ss.business_date=cast(asi.business_date as varchar)
	join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on mp.model_portfolio_id = shm.model_portfolio_id
    where mp.business_date = shm.business_date and shm.business_date = '2025-06-11'  
    AND ( mp.model_portfolio_id IN ('CICOCS','CIPCDMS','CIPCEMS','CREA','IPCCMGCRD2','IPCFITS','IPCMTNS','PMICMGCRD2','PMISHHGC','REFCMCNB','REFCMCNMB','REFCMFSB','RITORRE1','SHACRSS') ) 
    AND shm.abor_security_type_id  IN ('GOVMKT', 'REPO', 'REVREPO', 'NONMKT')
    AND NOT (
			shm.balance_nominal_number_unsettled = 0 
			and shm.balance_nominal_number = 0 
			and shm.clean_value_quotation_currency = 0
			and shm.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency = 0
			and shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency = 0
			and shm.next_dividend_quotation_currency = 0
			and shm.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency = 0)
	and (mp.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code not in ('EPM')
	or mp.model_portfolio_id in ('EPMHCRS','EPMCVSL','EPMDSPA','EPMFTPC','EPMMYAT','EPMNKTF','EPMBNPN','EPMSERK','EPMCVG2','EPMDSPI','EPMFTLB','EPMNKTD','EPMCVLD','EPMCVLG','EPMCVLR'))
    GROUP BY mp.model_portfolio_id, ss.abor_security_name_id, asi.isin , shm.abor_maturity_date, ss.abor_security_group_id,asi.cusip
    HAVING (ss.abor_security_group_id = 'BOND' AND ABS(SUM(shm.balance_nominal_number)) >= 1)
    OR (ss.abor_security_group_id = 'Security Lending' AND shm.abor_maturity_date > '2025-06-11') 
    ORDER BY ss.abor_security_group_id, mp.model_portfolio_id, ss.abor_security_name_id, shm.abor_maturity_date

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

FROM (with scd_perf as (

	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name

			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'

		, value

			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)

			select

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-31')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-31')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  COALESCE(staging.funding_currency, staging.deal_currency) AS funding_currency, 
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  staging.ticket_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  staging.probability_of_close AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  'Net Purchases and Sales' AS capital_usage_component,
  'Investment Funding/Distribution' AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  (COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * -1) AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_transactions_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_security_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- NULL on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  staging.transaction_code AS transaction_code,
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_unsettled_transactions_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list,
  'n' AS ignore_y_n
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_unsettled_transactions_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier and staging.run_id = reference.run_id
WHERE
  staging.run_id = 'cf920203-ee98-4d3f-9799-f86489e1395b'

	WHERE

	GROUP BY

) GROUP BY
	client_ip

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 11 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 12 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-11 23:36:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::675fc946e970a38073b8d07d4e8e4244095206eb32faccae8e5b256d8a0e3fac */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_uat
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_uat.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='BCPP'
    and sd.business_date = dh.business_date
where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-05'
    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,
       case
           when max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit) > 0 then round(sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *
                                                                     100, 2)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit))
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.gics_sector='Financials' and f.business_date = ule.business_date
         --and ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit is not null
		 -- and ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit != -1

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.bcpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-06-05'
group by ule.gics_sector, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(bcpp_credit_exposure) desc

var.benchmark_name,
var.hierarchy_type,
var.hierarchy_node,
CAST(var.var95 AS decimal(22,6)) as var95,
CAST(b.mean AS decimal(22,6)) as mean,
CAST(c.vol AS decimal(22,6)) as vol,
CAST(d.cs01 AS decimal(22,6)) as cs01,
CAST(e.dv01 AS decimal(22,6)) as dv01,
CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_var
where business_date = '2025-06-05' 
and benchmark_name = 'ATP ACPP' and hierarchy_type = 'ACCOUNT'
and analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' and percent_confidence_level = 95 and run_id = 'ATP_ACPP'
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_mean 
where business_date = '2025-06-05' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'

and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node

(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "vol", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol

(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as cs01, run_id
from (
select *, reduce(cs01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_cs01
where business_date = '2025-06-05'

select *, reduce(dv01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01
where business_date = '2025-06-05' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id

(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_level, pv, run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_pv 
where business_date = '2025-06-05'

and f.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and f.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node

SELECT "custom_sql_query"."dv01_currency" AS "dv01_currency",
  0 AS "temp_calculation_2",
  1 AS "temp_calculation_1"
FROM (
  SELECT a.business_date, a.position_key, a.dv01_currency, a.dv01_tenor, a.dv01_cad_value FROM "risk_prod"."rmv_dv01" a WHERE investment_strategy = 'Emerging Markets Fixed Income'
) "custom_sql_query"
  INNER JOIN (
  SELECT "benchmark_analytic"."application_id" AS "application_id__be",
    "benchmark_analytic"."benchmark_name" AS "benchmark_name__be",
    "benchmark_analytic"."business_date" AS "business_date__ben",
    "benchmark_analytic"."currency" AS "currency__benchmar",
    "benchmark_analytic"."curve" AS "curve__benchmark_a",
    "benchmark_analytic"."curve_type" AS "curve_type__benchm",

    "benchmark_analytic"."run_id" AS "run_id__benchmark_",
    "benchmark_analytic"."run_type" AS "run_type__benchmar",Tenor, dv01_benchmark_value
  
  FROM "risk_prod"."benchmark_analytic_dv01" "benchmark_analytic"
  CROSS JOIN unnest(terms,dv01) AS t(Tenor, dv01_benchmark_value)
  where "hierarchy_type" = 'investment_cell_emerging_mkt_fixed_income'

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 09:08:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with
	trans as (
		select * from (
		select
			trans.*,
			row_number() over (
		                partition by 
		                	trans.model_portfolio_id, 
		                	trans.abor_security_number, 
		                	trans.abor_transaction_number,
		                	trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key, -- same transaction number can have different primary key
		                	trans.elementary_transaction_code
						order by
							trans.changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
		           ) as rn
		from
			trades_deals.scd_transactions trans -- this is main transaction table
		WHERE
			trans.accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
			--AND trans.business_date > '2025-03-17' -- give T-8 business date so that it can fetch all data.
			--and trans.trade_date > '2025-03-25' -- trade date
			and cast(trans.settlement_date as date) >= date '2025-04-01' and cast(trans.settlement_date as date) <= DATE '2025-04-30' 
		)tt
		where tt.rn = 1
	),
	fin as (
        select * from (
        select
            fin.*,
            row_number() over (
                        partition by
                            fin.gl_account_id,
                            fin.gl_transaction_number,
                            fin.finance_transaction_index,
                            fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key,  -- same transaction number can have different primary key
                            fin.booking_type
                        order by
                            fin.extract_time desc
                   ) as rn
        from
            finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        where
            fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
            and fin.booking_type = 'Agreement date booking'
            and fin.gl_account_id in ('2115-0000-009','2115-0000-024','2115-0000-031','2115-0000-038','2115-0000-023','2115-0000-018','2115-0000-021')
            --and fin.gl_account_id not in ('1050-0000-010')
        )fn
        where fn.rn = 1
	)
	, MaxBusinessDates AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_portfolio) AS max_mp_bd,
        (select MAX(business_date) from reference.reference_currency_codes) as max_rcc_bd,
        (select MAX(business_date) from finance_accounting.scd_finance_accounts) as max_FA_bd
	)
	
Select 
trans.trade_date, 
trans.portfolio_id, 
trans.fx_rate_interest_currency_to_portfolio_currency, 
trans.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency, 
trans.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_settlement_currency, 
trans.settlement_date,
trans.transaction_number_in_originating_system, 
trans.abor_transaction_number, 
fintrans.credit_amount_quotation_currency, 
fintrans.credit_amount_portfolio_currency, 
fintrans.debit_amount_quotation_currency, 
fintrans.debit_amount_portfolio_currency, 
fintrans.gl_account_id, 
fintrans.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, 
trans.forward_current_value_portfolio_currency, 
trans.forward_current_value_quotation_currency, 
fintrans.gl_account_name, 
fintrans.finance_transaction_quotation_currency_name, 
fintrans.abor_finance_account, 
port.portfolio_group_name, 
rcc.currency_name
	from
		fin fintrans
	left join trans on trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fintrans.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
	left join reference.scd_portfolio port on port.business_date = (select max_mp_bd from MaxBusinessDates) and port.portfolio_id = trans.portfolio_id
    left join reference.reference_currency_codes rcc on rcc.business_date = (SELECT max_rcc_bd FROM MaxBusinessDates) and trans.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
	where
	    trans.abor_security_id NOT LIKE 'DUMMY%'
    	--AND trans.elementary_transaction_code NOT IN ('BalBook','EOP adj.')
		and trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'

        select
            scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
            model_portfolio_id,
            business_date,
            row_number() over ( partition by scd_model_portfolio_primary_key order by business_date desc ) new_to_old_rank
        from 
            (
                -- Goal is to keep only the latest record of each MP code
                select 
                    scd_model_portfolio_primary_key, 
                    model_portfolio_id, 
                    replace( business_date, '-', '' ) business_date,
                    row_number() over ( partition by model_portfolio_id order by business_date desc ) rownum
                from reference.scd_model_portfolio 
                where scd_model_portfolio_primary_key in 
                    (
                        -- Get unique MP primary keys that have more than one MP code associated with it
                        select scd_model_portfolio_primary_key --, min( model_portfolio_id ) oldest_mp, max( model_portfolio_id ) newest_mp, count( distinct model_portfolio_id) rename_count
                        from reference.scd_model_portfolio 
                        where business_date > '2024-01-01'
                        group by scd_model_portfolio_primary_key 
                        having count( distinct model_portfolio_id ) > 1
                    )
            ) mp_codes_with_row_number
        where 
            rownum = 1
    ),
    new_mp_list as (
        select 
            scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
            model_portfolio_id
        from renamed_mp_codes
        where new_to_old_rank = 1
    ),
    old_mp_list as (
        select 
            scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,

SELECT * FROM (SELECT *

  with ae_temp as (
      select investment_dept, investment_strat, business_date,
             (case when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then 0
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap') then abacus_notional_base_ccy + abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then 0 
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   else abacus_pv_base_ccy end
             ) as exposure
      from "risk_prod"."rmv_position"
      where investment_dept = 'Active Equities' and portfolio_type = 'IP' and product_type in ('Common Stock','Common Stock Private','Convertible_bond','Equity Swap','Private Emerging Mkt Fund', 'Synthetic Equity Index','Unit','Pooled Fund Absolute Return','Listed Warrant','Preferred Stock','REIT','Depository Receipt','Leveraged Loans') and long_short = 'LONG'
  ),

      from "risk_prod"."rmv_analytics"
      where node in ('Active Equities','Asia','Europe','LatAm','North America','AE Enhanced Beta')
      and portfolio_type = 'IP' 
      and analytic_name in ('10 Year VaR', '10 Year Volatility','2 Year VaR', '2 Year Volatility','5 Year Expected Shortfall') 
      and (confidence_level is null or confidence_level = 0.95)
  )
  
  select q1.business_date, q1.node_name, q1.long_pv, analytics.analytic_name, analytics.analytic_value,
         (analytics.analytic_value / q1.long_pv) * 100 as "% analytics"
  from (
      select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_strat as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv

      group by ae_temp.investment_strat, ae_temp.business_date
  
      union
  
      select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_dept as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv 
      from ae_temp
      group by ae_temp.investment_dept, ae_temp.business_date
  ) as q1
  right join analytics 
  on q1.business_date = analytics.business_date and q1.node_name = analytics.node
) "custom_sql_query"
LIMIT 0) T LIMIT 0

    WITH latest_business_date AS (

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,

-- Query # 13 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined'

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c ON b.business_date = c.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = c.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 13 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i
